import type { SecurityRequirement } from "../runtime/auth.ts";
import type { MediaDeclaration } from "../runtime/negotiate.ts";
import * as Serialize from "../runtime/serialize.ts";

export interface FormInput {
  readonly body: Serialize.Json | undefined;
}

/**
 * Request builder for lone form, not an HttpApi definition.
 */
export const form = (input: FormInput): Serialize.Request =>
  Serialize.request("POST", {
    body: Serialize.urlEncoded("application/x-www-form-urlencoded", input.body, {
      properties: [
        ["content", {}],
        ["tags", { explode: false }],
        ["ids", {}],
      ],
      required: true,
    }),
    headers: [],
    path: Serialize.path("/lone/form", []),
    query: [],
  });

const formMedia: MediaDeclaration = {
  request: ["application/x-www-form-urlencoded"],
  responses: { "204": [] },
};

const formSecurity: SecurityRequirement = [];

export const formMeta = {
  media: formMedia,
  method: "POST",
  operationId: "lone-form",
  origin: { document: "openapi.json", pointer: "/paths/~1lone~1form/post" },
  pathTemplate: "/lone/form",
  security: formSecurity,
};

export interface JsonInput {
  readonly body: Serialize.Body;
}

/**
 * Request builder for lone json, not an HttpApi definition.
 */
export const json = (input: JsonInput): Serialize.Request =>
  Serialize.request("POST", {
    body: Serialize.body("application/json", input.body),
    headers: [],
    path: Serialize.path("/lone/json", []),
    query: [],
  });

const jsonMedia: MediaDeclaration = { request: ["application/json"], responses: { "204": [] } };

const jsonSecurity: SecurityRequirement = [];

export const jsonMeta = {
  media: jsonMedia,
  method: "POST",
  operationId: "lone-json",
  origin: { document: "openapi.json", pointer: "/paths/~1lone~1json/post" },
  pathTemplate: "/lone/json",
  security: jsonSecurity,
};

export interface MultipartInput {
  readonly body: Serialize.FormFields;
}

/**
 * Request builder for lone multipart, not an HttpApi definition.
 */
export const multipart = (input: MultipartInput): Serialize.Request =>
  Serialize.request("POST", {
    body: Serialize.formData(input.body, {
      parts: [
        ["content", "text/plain"],
        ["file", "application/octet-stream"],
      ],
      required: true,
    }),
    headers: [],
    path: Serialize.path("/lone/multipart", []),
    query: [],
  });

const multipartMedia: MediaDeclaration = {
  request: ["multipart/form-data"],
  responses: { "204": [] },
};

const multipartSecurity: SecurityRequirement = [];

export const multipartMeta = {
  media: multipartMedia,
  method: "POST",
  operationId: "lone-multipart",
  origin: { document: "openapi.json", pointer: "/paths/~1lone~1multipart/post" },
  pathTemplate: "/lone/multipart",
  security: multipartSecurity,
};
